For over two decades, writing has been at the heart of my creative work, spanning screenwriting, advertising, journalism and translation.

This year marked the publication of my debut novel, _Boguizanogu (Godknowswhere)_, a coming-of-age story set in the summer of 1980, the first summer following the death of Josip Broz Tito, Yugoslavia’s long-standing authoritarian leader.

Throughout my career, my creative practice has been rooted in storytelling and narrative development. I have worked as a screenwriter, script consultant (script doctor), and documentary film producer, exploring different ways of shaping stories and bringing them to life.
